The odd two-dimensional modular-form route can terminate with an exact representation comparison, while approximate even Maass-form computation cannot play that role. The paper therefore seeks a conditional finite-height certificate: when its announced criterion is satisfied it proves holomorphy only up to the chosen height and otherwise may yield partial pole bounds, not a general decision algorithm.
